meta.description: Checks that the method an AIIR commit receipt used to determine authorship is one of the methods allowed by the `allowedDetectionMethods` context value, a pipe-separated list. Projects that only trust certain detection methods can enforce that preference here.
meta.name: Allowed Detection Methods

allowedDetectionMethods.description: Pipe-separated list of allowed AIIR detection_method values

error.message: AIIR detection method is not allowed
error.guidance: This repo does not accept revisions whose AIIR receipt uses detection method {{ .Outputs.detectionMethod }}
